name: com.jlinkdev.volumetric-fog-and-rain
description: World-space rain, atmospheric fog, interactive GPU ground mist, wet surfaces, glass refraction and splash particles for Unity 6 URP Render Graph.

samples.description: Explore a storm-lit courtyard and its dry observation shelter. Compare rain on stone, splash impacts and wet-glass refraction under the same storm.
A sheltered dawn courtyard where atmospheric haze and simulated ground mist meet around a row of stone slabs.
A stone hall with an animated character, persistent ground-mist wakes, gusts and solid obstacles.
